title: Superseded diagnostic draft: block-4 affine FP16 W4A8 V21

authoritative_containment.required_disposition: Stop V21 and quantizer cycling. Do not create a backlog item, official runner, namespace, marker, construction, candidate text, or quality campaign. Preserve this file only as a superseded non-authoritative diagnostic draft pending an explicit model/weights contract change.

refreeze_provenance.reason: The first marker-free codec control compared FP32 intermediate reconstructions while labeling the decode as final BF16. Before any official namespace, authority, runner, or candidate text existed, the control was corrected to round reconstructed values to BF16 and V21 was refrozen.

objective: Historical diagnostic description only. This draft must not be used to route, implement, construct, evaluate, or select a V21 candidate.

selection_boundary.rule: Choose from the predeclared structural affine codec set using pinned source weights only: minimum aggregate literal-BF16 reconstruction SSE, with all 169 tensors nonregressing versus V20, legal finite metadata for the complete source geometry, deterministic scalar/tensor codec identity, and an actual uint4 payload.
prohibited_selection_inputs: V20 concise_summary case identity or input IDs
V20 expected sentence behavior or decoded output
V20 first-token margin or any case-specific logit observable
prompt text, token outputs, hidden harnesses, golden outputs, response gates, or product-case lookup
the diagnostic post-V20 BF16/W4/W4A8 divergence trace
selection_boundary.diagnostic_trace_status: retained only as non-authoritative perturbation localization; it does not establish the cause of the V20 regression and does not justify V21

terminal_predecessor.required_treatment: Preserve V20 and its consumed one-shot evidence unchanged. Do not replay, resume, repair, regenerate, overwrite, import its runner as the V21 implementation, or use its failed case to tune V21.

representation.scope: all 169 nn.Linear tensors including a storage-detached lm_head; source embedding and all non-Linear tensors remain BF16
representation.block_order: output-row major, then contiguous four-weight input block, then lane 0 through lane 3
representation.payload: one unsigned uint4 affine code per Linear weight; lanes 0 and 2 occupy low nibbles and lanes 1 and 3 occupy high nibbles of their respective bytes
representation.metadata_record: one little-endian IEEE-754 FP16 minimum offset followed by one little-endian IEEE-754 FP16 affine step per row-local four-weight block
representation.encode: Read the four source BF16 values as FP32. Round the minimum to FP16 offset and round (maximum - minimum)/15 to FP16 step. For a constant block, emit zero step and four zero codes. Otherwise require decoded step greater than zero, round (value - decoded_offset)/decoded_step to nearest with ties to even, and clamp to 0..15.
representation.decode: For each code, compute FP32(FP16 offset) + uint4_code * FP32(FP16 step), then round the reconstructed Linear weight to BF16.
representation.illegal: Reject non-finite source values or metadata and reject a nonconstant block whose FP16 step is zero or nonpositive.

storage_and_memory_contract.payload_stream: contiguous row-major packed nibbles, with base and total length 16-byte aligned and no per-row padding
storage_and_memory_contract.metadata_stream: contiguous offset_u16_le,step_u16_le records, with base and total length 16-byte aligned and no per-block or per-row padding
storage_and_memory_contract.aligned_traffic_fact: Eight four-weight blocks cover 32 weights and consume 16 payload bytes plus 32 metadata bytes, exactly 48 bytes or three 128-bit beats.
storage_and_memory_contract.claim_boundary: These are exact representation and byte-traffic facts, not measured RTL latency, throughput, timing, area, power, hardware-emulation, or board results.
